# Vogue

> > Vogue is the definitive voice in fashion, beauty, culture, and lifestyle, celebrating style, creativity, and influential voices shaping contemporary culture.

Vogue covers haute couture, runway trends, celebrity style, beauty innovations, and cultural commentary. The publication also champions women's excellence through signature events like Vogue Values, honoring changemakers and leaders across industries.

## Key Topics

- Fashion and Style
- Beauty and Wellness
- Celebrity Culture
- Women's Empowerment
- Vogue Values
- Leadership Awards
- Changemakers
- Mumbai Events
- Women of Excellence
- Tira Partnership
- Cultural Commentary
- Runway and Haute Couture

## Signature Events and Awards

- [Vogue Values: Women of Excellence](https://events.vogue.com/vogue-values-2026): Vogue Values awards event celebrating women leaders in Mumbai with Tira
